methodology.model: Realistic operational completion: software capability plus evidence-readiness, while genuine live-source coverage is reported separately and never inferred from Production GREEN.
methodology.weighting: equal weight across 36 AI Data Platform operational categories
methodology.buildRule: Every numbered build must move this operational denominator by 5-10 percentage points unless the denominator is deliberately re-baselined first.
methodology.liveEvidenceRule: Missing signer/token enrollment, transport review or independent reboot witness remains HOLD and does not become live-connected because this score advances.

categories.name: Master command center & operator visibility
categories.rationale: Adds a dedicated seven-source live-operational command view with explicit HOLD/accepted states.

categories.name: Data collection & intake
categories.rationale: Adds a governed intake path for enrollment, signed telemetry review and Sysop procedure evidence.

categories.name: Data review & approval
categories.rationale: Adds owner-reviewed acceptance events layered over immutable Build 423 signed receipts.

categories.name: Data quality & validation
categories.rationale: Separates signed-source validity, transport review, freshness and live acceptance instead of collapsing them.

categories.name: Provenance & lineage
categories.rationale: Links enrollment, receipt, acceptance and Sysop evidence by exact application and source revision.

categories.name: Search & reporting
categories.rationale: Adds per-application statistical rollups, source state, latest event and operational evidence visibility.

categories.name: Corrective operations & reconciliation
categories.rationale: Adds explicit HOLD reasons and owner-reviewed operational closure rather than inferred remediation.

categories.name: Application registry & module lifecycle
categories.rationale: All seven application identities are first-class operational evidence subjects with exact revision binding.

categories.name: Cross-application data contracts
categories.rationale: Build 425 reuses the canonical seven-app source contract and keeps cross-app authority source-owned.

categories.name: Event bus, delivery & replay
categories.rationale: Signed receipt, anti-replay, freshness and separate transport acceptance are surfaced as one governed chain.

categories.name: Source onboarding, signer & trust
categories.rationale: Adds source enrollment evidence, signer fingerprint/revision custody and owner-reviewed acceptance without storing secrets.

categories.name: Connector setup & diagnostics
categories.rationale: Adds transport/enrollment diagnostics and distinguishes NOT_ENROLLED, SIGNED_ONLY and LIVE_ACCEPTED.

categories.name: Shared identity & customer resolution
categories.rationale: Operational source identity is bound to exact app/revision while customer identities remain source-owned.

categories.name: Shared scheduling & work queue
categories.rationale: Operational queue/rollup status is exposed without granting source scheduling authority.

categories.name: Tenant/workspace isolation & authorization
categories.rationale: Owner/operator-only evidence access and owner-only acceptance writes preserve least privilege.

categories.name: Consent & notification governance
categories.rationale: Operational evidence keeps consent/communications authority separate from telemetry observation.

categories.name: Data classification
categories.rationale: Operational evidence uses aggregate non-sensitive telemetry classes and exact application identity.

categories.name: Encryption & secret custody
categories.rationale: Signer fingerprints and custody evidence are recorded without private keys or read tokens entering GitHub/DB evidence.

categories.name: Redaction & data minimization
categories.rationale: Rollups expose aggregate-only statistics and never persist raw secrets/customer payloads.

categories.name: Retention & expiry
categories.rationale: Evidence freshness/expiry is enforced for enrollment, acceptance and Sysop procedure records.

categories.name: Deletion evidence & legal holds
categories.rationale: Recovery/procedure receipts are append-only and preserve legal/audit evidence rather than mutating history.

categories.name: DLP & export controls
categories.rationale: Telemetry remains non-authorizing and cannot be used as an export/control bypass.

categories.name: Privileged operations & owner gates
categories.rationale: Owner-only acceptance and evidence review strengthen consequential-operation gates.

categories.name: Audit & evidence immutability
categories.rationale: Adds append-only enrollment, telemetry acceptance and Sysop procedure ledgers with FORCE RLS.

categories.name: Incident response, recovery & rollback
categories.rationale: Adds current recovery/reboot/backup/incident procedure evidence as explicit operational inputs.

categories.name: Performance & capacity governance
categories.rationale: Adds p95 latency, queue, failures and active-session fields to the seven-source operating picture when sources provide them.

categories.name: Desktop UX & accessibility
categories.rationale: Adds a compact command view that retains existing desktop accessibility controls.

categories.name: Tablet UX & accessibility
categories.rationale: Operational evidence cards are simplified for tablet-sized review.

categories.name: Mobile UX & accessibility
categories.rationale: Compact per-source status/metrics improve mobile review while dense evidence entry remains admin-oriented.

categories.name: Offline/degraded-network resilience
categories.rationale: Stale/missing source evidence remains HOLD and can recover without destructive state changes.

categories.name: Theme & design system
categories.rationale: Uses the existing 16-theme Master design system without changing application authority.

categories.name: Workflow automation & AI suggestions
categories.rationale: Supports supervised evidence intake/review workflows; no automatic operational action is introduced.

categories.name: External runtime/original-host evidence
categories.rationale: Adds original-host Sysop procedure evidence and independently witnessed reboot requirements while retaining Hub authority.

categories.name: Cross-application live operational evidence
categories.rationale: Adds the full live-acceptance software chain but keeps genuine source coverage separate; zero live sources remains zero.

categories.name: Release/CI/migration engineering
categories.rationale: Adds migration 0188, Build 425 verifier and exact-SHA release gating.

categories.name: Documentation, help & runbooks
categories.rationale: Publishes the operational re-baseline, evidence model, API contract and live-source closure runbook.
